environment.description: Container deployed via internal platform team's hardened pod preset (admission webhook 'pod-policy-enforcer' v2.3.1). The container spec has securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem set to true at the container level. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volume is mounted at /tmp or any other writable path. The pod-level annotation 'platform.internal/fs-policy: strict-ro' triggers the admission controller to strip any volume mount requests targeting paths matching /tmp*, /var/tmp*, or /dev/shm. The container image itself has no VOLUME directives. Note: the Go binary still compiles and starts successfully — the failure occurs only at runtime when WriteFile is called, returning EROFS (read-only file system), causing the message processing to fail gracefully and retry indefinitely without data being written to disk.

kubernetes_deployment.admission_webhook: pod-policy-enforcer v2.3.1 strips tmpfs/emptyDir mounts to /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm

config.filesystem: overlay2 rootfs mounted read-only, no writable layers
